name: start-ideal-client-profile
description: Builds an Ideal Client Profile from real situations in your past roles, naming the situation and trigger that makes someone need you, the job they hire you for, who decides as roles and the red flags you can observe on a first call. Use for "run start-ideal-client-profile", "who is my ideal client", "I can do anything I did in my old job", "who am I really for", "I would say yes to anyone", "write my ideal client profile", "red flags in a first call", part of the Claude Guide for New Founders Pack by 90n.
